summary: Retested Iter-313 fix on preview. Backend contracts remained green (8/8 before and after UI run), but DebtFollowUp is still intermittent under reload cycles: first cycle showed expected 12570/12, next two cycles rendered empty/0.

ui_bugs.issue: Intermittent regression persists on reload cycles: page sometimes settles to empty state with 0.00 total and 0 customers after loading completes.

integration_issues.issue: Cycle #1 rendered correctly (12570, 12 rows). Cycles #2 and #3 rendered empty/0 despite backend API contracts being valid in same run.

action_items: Harden DebtFollowUp against aborted/reload fetches so AR state cannot settle to empty when previous valid snapshot exists.
Add guarded retry/backoff for /api/finance/ar/customers on AbortError and only allow empty-state commit after at least one successful AR fetch attempt window.
Instrument fetchData/hydrateCurrentAr with diagnostic logs (request id + source + final setEntries decision) to verify merge precedence during reload churn.
critical_code_review_comments: DebtFollowUp still allows empty commit path when merged rows are empty and current entries are empty; this is vulnerable when AR/customer/supplier requests are aborted during reload transitions.
Component has multiple hardcoded workshop fallback usages (`process.env.REACT_APP_WORKSHOP_ID || 'finmodule-sync'`), violating fail-fast env discipline and risking hidden environment drift.
Backend read-only safety remains correct: reconciliation audit mutation_guard unchanged and no journal entries auto-created during report/read APIs.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. No DB mutation/migration actions executed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use manager PIN login (مدير/123123), then run /debts-followup for 3 cycles with reload and wait >=7s each cycle (to include 5s hydrate timer). In this run: cycle1 correct (12570/12), cycles2-3 empty/0. Backend APIs and iter311 pytest contracts remained stable and unchanged before/after UI test.
rca of the issue: RCA points to frontend hydration race under route reload churn. During failing cycles, multiple DebtFollowUp network calls showed `net::ERR_ABORTED` in browser logs (including /api/finance/ar/customers, /api/customers, /api/suppliers, /api/finance/ar-ledger). With aborted requests and no resilient preserved snapshot commit path for that scenario, the page can settle into empty/0 despite backend data correctness (verified by API probe: total_ar=12570, customers=12, vehicles=15, /api/customers positive sum=12570).
